name: RIT - HubSpot Weekly Invoice → Xero Invoice Sync

nodes.name: Workflow Config
nodes.notes: Xero values carried over from the original workflow; HubSpot values added. Read by name from every other node.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ ({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: $('Workflow Config').first().json.companyFlagProperty, operator: 'GT', value: '0' }] }], properties: $('Workflow Config').first().json.companyProps, sorts: [{ propertyName: 'hs_object_id', direction: 'ASCENDING' }], limit: 100 }) }}

nodes.name: Search Companies With Delivered Assets
nodes.notes: Companies where asset_delivered > 0, 100 per page, paged until HubSpot stops returning a next cursor.

nodes.name: Collect Companies
nodes.notes: One context item for the whole run. Fails the run if the pages collected do not add up to HubSpot's total. Ends the run cleanly when no company qualifies.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ ({ filterGroups: [{ filters: [{ propertyName: 'type', operator: 'EQ', value: $('Workflow Config').first().json.invoiceType }, { propertyName: 'hs_createdate', operator: 'GTE', value: String($('Workflow Config').first().json.windowStartMs) }, { propertyName: 'hs_createdate', operator: 'LTE', value: String($('Workflow Config').first().json.windowEndMs) }] }], properties: ['type', 'hs_invoice_status', 'hs_createdate', 'xero_invoice_id'], sorts: [{ propertyName: 'hs_object_id', direction: 'ASCENDING' }], limit: 100 }) }}

nodes.name: Search Recent Weekly Invoices
nodes.notes: ONE portal-wide search instead of a read per company: Weekly invoices created TODAY (start of day, Brisbane). Invoices with no company are ignored in 'Apply Guard'.

nodes.name: Index Guard Invoices
nodes.notes: Collapses the search pages. Fails the run if the pages do not add up to HubSpot's total.

nodes.name: Any Guard Invoices?
nodes.notes: False: nothing to check, skip the company lookup.

nodes.name: Chunk Guard Invoice IDs
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of guard invoice ids.

nodes.name: Read Guard Invoice Companies
nodes.notes: Which company each guard invoice belongs to, 50 invoices per call.

nodes.name: Apply Guard
nodes.notes: Per company (invoices with no company are ignored): today's open/paid Weekly invoice = already invoiced (skip). Today's Weekly drafts = leftovers to archive. Open invoices missing a Xero ID = pending for Xero.

nodes.name: Leftover Drafts?
nodes.notes: True: a failed run earlier today left Weekly draft invoices. Archive them before creating new ones.

nodes.name: Chunk Draft Invoice IDs
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of draft invoice ids.

nodes.name: Read Draft Line Item Links
nodes.notes: Line items hanging off the leftover drafts, so they are archived too.

nodes.name: Build Draft Archive Batches
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: archive batches, line items first then invoices.

nodes.name: Archive Draft Records
nodes.notes: Archives one batch (line_items or invoices). Archiving twice is harmless, so retry is safe.

parameters.jsCode:
// Collapses the cleanup batches (or the no-cleanup path) back into the single context item.
return [{ json: $('Apply Guard').first().json }];

nodes.name: Guard Cleared
nodes.notes: Convergence point: collapses the cleanup batches (or the no-cleanup path) into the single context item.

nodes.name: Any Eligible Companies?
nodes.notes: False: every company is already invoiced; go straight to Xero for anything pending.

nodes.name: Chunk Eligible Companies
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of company ids.

nodes.name: Read Company Asset Links
nodes.notes: Assets associated to each company, 50 companies per call.

nodes.name: Collect Asset Links
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches. Companies with no assets are finished (no_assets); a company whose list is longer than one read is skipped and reported.

nodes.name: Any Assets To Read?
nodes.notes: False: nothing to read.

nodes.name: Chunk Asset IDs
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of asset ids.

nodes.name: Read Assets
nodes.notes: Asset properties, 50 per call.

nodes.name: Collect Billable Assets
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches. Keeps Active / To be Returned assets per company; companies with none are finished (no_active_assets).

nodes.name: Any Billable Assets?
nodes.notes: False: nothing billable.

nodes.name: Chunk Asset Link Reads
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of billable asset ids.

nodes.name: Read Asset Line Item Links
nodes.notes: Which line items hang off each billable asset, 50 per call.

nodes.name: Collect Line Item Links
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches. A company whose assets have no line items is finished (no_line_items).

nodes.name: Any Line Item Links?
nodes.notes: False: no line items to read.

nodes.name: Chunk Line Item IDs
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of source line item ids.

nodes.name: Read Line Items
nodes.notes: Source line items (name, price, quantity, product, SKU, description), 50 per call.

nodes.name: Build Invoice Plan
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches and builds each company's invoice lines: price x quantity as one unit, asset number fallback, contract / serial in the description. A bad company is skipped and reported, not fatal.

nodes.name: Any Invoices To Create?
nodes.notes: False: nothing to invoice.

nodes.name: Chunk Contact Reads
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of company ids.

nodes.name: Read Company Contacts
nodes.notes: Contacts on each company with association labels, to find the Billing Contact.

nodes.name: Plan Invoice Creates
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches. Builds one draft invoice per company: AUD, invoice date = the FOLLOWING Monday, due date = that week's Tue-Fri from the company's Weekly Invoice Expiry Date, type Weekly, associated to the company and its Billing Contact.

nodes.name: Chunk Invoice Creates
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of up to 50 invoices to create.

nodes.name: Create Draft Invoices
nodes.notes: Creates 50 draft invoices per call, already associated to their company. NO retry: a retry after a lost response would duplicate them.

nodes.name: Chunk Created Invoice IDs
nodes.notes: Collapses the create responses and checks the count. FAN-OUT: batches of new invoice ids.

nodes.name: Read Created Invoice Companies
nodes.notes: Reads back which company each new invoice belongs to (response order is not relied on).

nodes.name: Plan Line Item Creates
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches. Pairs every new invoice with its company and builds the line items, each already associated to its invoice.

nodes.name: Chunk Line Item Creates
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of up to 50 line items to create.

nodes.name: Create Invoice Line Items
nodes.notes: Creates 50 line items per call, each already associated to its invoice. NO retry (create call).

nodes.name: Collect Created Line Items
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches. Fails (leaving drafts that the next run archives) if any line item failed or the count is short. Nothing is opened until every line item exists.

nodes.name: Chunk Invoice Opens
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of invoices to move draft -> open.

nodes.name: Open Invoices
nodes.notes: Moves openBatchSize invoices per call from draft to open, one call every 2 s. A flag write, so retry is safe (5 s between tries). A failed batch no longer stops the run: Confirm Opened Invoices reports it.

nodes.name: Confirm Opened Invoices
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches and checks every invoice was updated. Records the result per company.

nodes.name: Gather Xero Invoices
nodes.notes: Convergence point for every path. Xero candidates = invoices created this run + today's open invoices that never reached Xero.

nodes.name: Any Invoices For Xero?
nodes.notes: False: nothing to send to Xero.

nodes.name: Chunk Xero Invoice IDs
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of invoice ids.

nodes.name: Read Xero Invoice Details
nodes.notes: Invoice number, PO, owner, dates and the Xero dedup flag, 50 invoices per call (replaces the per-invoice reads).

nodes.name: Index Invoice Details
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches. Drops invoices already in Xero (xero_invoice_id set) or not open.

nodes.name: Any Invoices Need Xero?
nodes.notes: False: everything is already in Xero.

nodes.name: Chunk Invoice Line Item Link Reads
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of invoice ids.

nodes.name: Read Invoice Line Item Links
nodes.notes: Line items on each invoice, 50 invoices per call.

nodes.name: Collect Invoice Line Items Links
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches into invoice -> line item ids.

nodes.name: Any Xero Line Items To Read?
nodes.notes: False: no line items anywhere; the invoices are reported as failures.

nodes.name: Chunk Xero Line Item IDs
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: batches of line item ids.

nodes.name: Read Xero Line Items
nodes.notes: Line item amount, name, asset number, serial number, 50 per call.

nodes.name: Build Xero Invoices
nodes.notes: Collapses the batches and builds the complete Xero invoice for each HubSpot invoice (state -> rental income account). Invoices that cannot be built are returned as failures, never silently dropped.

nodes.name: Any Prepared Invoices?
nodes.notes: False: nothing to send; go to the summary.

parameters.jsCode:
// One item per prepared Xero invoice, in the shape the batch loop below expects.
return $input.first().json.prepared.map(p => ({ json: p }));

nodes.name: Split Prepared Invoices
nodes.notes: FAN-OUT: one item per prepared invoice for the Xero batch loop (unchanged phase from the original workflow).

nodes.name: Build Preflight Error Tasks
nodes.notes: Turns invoices that could not be prepared into HubSpot task inputs (these used to be dropped silently). Emits nothing when there are none.

nodes.name: Create Preflight Error Tasks
nodes.notes: One HubSpot call per batch of prepare failures.

nodes.name: Loop Over Xero Batches
nodes.notes: PHASE 2 (create) - one pass per batch of invoices (size from Workflow Config). Output 1 = this batch, Output 0 (done) = finished.

nodes.name: Build Xero Batch Payload
nodes.notes: Collapses the batch to a single item: { payload, submitted }.

nodes.name: Create Xero Invoices (Batch)
nodes.notes: ONE call for the whole batch. summarizeErrors=false => HTTP 200 even if individual invoices are rejected; 'Parse Xero Batch Results' checks each one. No retryOnFail: this is a create.

nodes.name: Parse Xero Batch Results
nodes.notes: Checks every invoice individually, guards the count and invoice-number mapping, outputs { okInvoices, failures }.

nodes.name: Any Invoices Created?
nodes.notes: TRUE: write the Xero IDs back to HubSpot. FALSE: nothing was created, go straight to the error tasks.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ inputs: $json.okInvoices.map((o) => ({ id: o.hubspotInvoiceId, properties: { xero_invoice_id: o.xeroInvoiceId } })) }) }}

nodes.name: Write Xero IDs to HubSpot (Batch)
nodes.notes: Sets xero_invoice_id on every invoice just created - this is the dedup flag. Idempotent (same values on retry), so retryOnFail is safe here. 'Build Batch Error Tasks' checks the result.

nodes.name: Build Batch Error Tasks
nodes.notes: Always outputs exactly one item so the loop can continue. taskInputs may be empty.

nodes.name: Any Error Tasks?
nodes.notes: TRUE: create the tasks. FALSE: skip straight to the wait.

nodes.name: Create Error Tasks (Batch)
nodes.notes: One HubSpot call for all of this batch's failures. Deliberately no onError override: if the tasks cannot be created the run should fail loudly (Error Workflow) rather than hide the failures. Re-running is safe - invoices that already have xero_invoice_id are skipped.

nodes.name: Wait Between Batches
nodes.notes: Throttle between batches (seconds from Workflow Config), then back to the batch loop.

nodes.name: Run Summary
nodes.notes: Last step on every path. Logs the counts; throws if any company or invoice needs a person so the Error Workflow alerts once, after everything else has finished.
